BiblicalUsage: Paran is the wilderness where Ishmael grows up and takes a wife from Egypt, and where Israel camps on the way from Sinai. From its mountain God is said to shine forth when He comes with ten thousands of saints.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wilderness of Paran shows that God meets His people in the empty places: a boy cast out, a nation wandering, and a mountain shining all belong to the same story.
